notes.title: Tavern Manager Simulator Biggest Update
notes.content:
This is our biggest update yet, celebrating the game's anniversary! We've added 4 new tavern levels and new mechanics!


🎶Musicians and Concerts
What's a tavern without bards? Hire musicians and organize concerts in your tavern. Let your patrons dance!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/7df8a49461598fe399c80d6489d37f8edba02a8d.gif"]


👑Long Live the King! 
The King himself may visit your tavern. Organize a grand feast for him, and perhaps he'll decide that your tavern is the best in the entire kingdom.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/9684524e0c65a3825f65e1d8b5df222174d57793.png"]


🏺Artifact Display Cases and Magic Flowers
Put your artifacts on public display for all patrons to admire. And if you want to speed up your fairies, use the flowers they love so much.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/27bccf88237e9d2760b1ab5bda801572bd9daf88.gif"]



Return to the tavern and build the Best Tavern Ever!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2756770/Tavern_Manager_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]

🎉 Announcement: Anime Shop Simulator
If you want to support us, then add our next game to your Wishlist - a co-op anime shop simulator



Manage your own anime shop . Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business. Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game 🕹️

notes.title: MUG UPDATE: GAMEPLAY AND OPTIMIZATION IMPROVEMENTS
notes.content:
From clicker to idler
Now the game starts out as a clicker, but as it progresses it becomes an automatic drink pourer. You can even minimize the window and try to score the maximum number of points!

Achievement
The game had problems with achievements at release. We counted them incorrectly and it was impossible to get them all. We fixed it and checked it again.

Optimization
At launch, due to incorrect settings on our side, the game consumed a lot of video memory. We have fixed this problem - now the game should work adequately on most devices. If you have any problems, please contact us with the configuration of your device.

notes.title: MUG NEW VERSION: new gameplay and improvements
notes.content:
